useCase: Localizing manipulated regions and creating 조작 probability heatmaps
mechanism: Divides the image into overlapping patches and classifies each independently using a lightweight CNN. Creates a spatial probability map showing 조작 likelihood per region. Aggregates patch-level predictions for an overall assessment. Effective at localizing manipulated regions 내의 an image.
name: 패치 기반 포렌식 (CNN)
source: Chai et al. (2020) - What Makes Fake Images Detectable? Understanding Properties that Generalize, ECCV
parameters: Patch size: 128x128, Stride: 64, CNN: custom lightweight (4 conv layers), Aggregation: mean + max pooling of patch scores
description: 사용합니다 CNN classifiers on small image patches 감지하기 위해 local 조작s. Each patch is independently classified, creating a 조작 probability map.

references.title: Chai, L. et al. (2020). What Makes Fake Images Detectable? Understanding Properties that Generalize. ECCV.
Wang, S.Y. et al. (2020). CNN-Generated Images Are Surprisingly Easy to Spot...For Now. CVPR.

strengths:
• Provides spatial localization of 조작s
• Lightweight and fast inference
• Generalizes 에 걸친 different 조작 types
• Can detect partial 이미지 조작s
limitations:
• Small patch size may miss global 불일치
• Boundary effects 사이의 patches
• Performance depends on training data diversity
